intro.text: *sniff* M-my kitten Mochi ran away toward the big hill... and I'm not allowed to leave the village.

choices.text: Don't cry. I'll find Mochi for you.
choices.reason: Promised to find Lina's lost kitten

choices.text: Cats always come home. You'll see.
Stop whining, it's just a cat.
choices.reason: Told a crying child to stop whining

thanks.text: Really?! She's orange with a white tail. Please hurry!

unsure.text: ...You think so? *sniff* But it's so far...

cry.text: *Lina bursts into tears and turns away.*

sulk.text: *Lina glares at you, eyes still red.*

choices.text: I'm sorry. I'll find Mochi for you.

waiting.text: Did you find Mochi? She's orange with a white tail! Somewhere near the big hill...

reunion.text: MOCHI! You found her! Here, my lucky charm. It's yours now, you need it more than me!

happy.text: Mochi and I are going to be explorers, just like you!
